Package model.users

Class Student

java.lang.Object
model.users.User
model.users.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Student>, Observer
Direct Known Subclasses:
GraduateStudent
public class Student extends User implements Comparable<Student>, Serializable
Represents a university Student. A student can register for courses (subject to the 21-credit cap), view marks, access their transcript, rate teachers, and join student organisations. Implements Comparable to support GPA-based ranking.
